_comment: Canonical-vocabulary gate for SSQL. `denied` lists non-Sanskrit or wrong words that must not appear in any user-facing text (keywords, identifiers, examples, docs, UI, converter output, messages); each entry matches as a substring of a Devanagari word. Orthography rules (final anusvāra, anusvāra before a stop, chandrabindu, nukta, underscores) are applied in code. An entry with `retired_keyword` was once an SSQL keyword; the lexer rejects any word containing it, with the replacement as a hint. A line that must name a denied word (e.g. the compiler's hint table) carries the marker `lexicon-allow` and is only permitted in .rs/.py files.

denied.why: Hindi sense 'hour' (Sanskrit घण्टा is a bell)
